end.line: Quillon for Redfern Sloane’s real estate finance team

vo: Redfern Sloane reviews about five hundred loan packs a year, checking title reports against facility terms by hand.
Vault reads the whole loan pack at once, and every title issue comes back flagged in one table.
Ask whether a charge conflicts with the facility, and the answer comes back cited to the page.
In Word, the facility agreement is redlined to your playbook, with every change explained beside it.
Ethan will walk your team through it on Thursday the nineteenth.
